script: The mantis shrimp throws one of the fastest punches in the animal kingdom. Its club-like arm strikes at about 80 kilometers per hour. The strike is so fast it makes bubbles that collapse with a tiny flash of light and heat. It uses this punch to smash open snail and crab shells. Its eyes have 12 or more kinds of color receptors, while human eyes have just 3. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
title: The Mantis Shrimp Punches at 80 km/h #MantisShrimp #Ocean #Shorts
